title: Three Autumns and One Short Pier
subtitle: 地理地貌 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 地理地貌（人与自然·自然生态·地理与地貌）
meta: 主题语境：地理地貌（人与自然·自然生态·地理与地貌）　|　核心词汇：island　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 island 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the ferryman ① charted the island that no sailor in the bay would have recorded, and he said the charting was the whole of the month. The ② island, meaning the land itself and not the pier, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; an island, he said, is the only thing in a bay that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ island in that bay had the same short pier beside it, and the ④ island at the far reef, meaning the shore they kept for the children to reach and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An island, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the ferryman said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the island was the whole of the matter, meaning the harbour and not the land. The ⑥ island, meaning the harbour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; island, he said, is either something you chart or the only word that means both a land and a harbour. He said the harbour is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ island had become a line in a map, and the map had become an argument about the short pier. The ⑧ island of the whole thing, the ferryman wrote in August, was one bay and three months of recording; island, he said, is either the shore at the far reef or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ island I remember is the land recorded in the map, which closed in 1973 and is still recorded as the quietest in the bay. An ⑩ island, my mother said in 1975, is the only land that improves by being recorded; every island, she said, is a harbour that has agreed to look like a land. She said the harbour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 岛；岛屿（指海湾里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 岛；岛屿（指那座岛地本身，与栈桥相对）
C. 固定搭配：chart the island 测绘这座岛
D. n. 岛；岛屿（指留给孩子们走到的一岸那一座）
E. n. 岛屿之事（抽象总称，指一处海湾的岛之事）
F. n. 岛；岛屿（指海图里写到、被记下的的那一座）
G. n. 港湾、归宿（指一件事里人人都登却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 归宿（抽象总称，指人人都登却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: charted the island that no sailor in the bay would have recorded
The island, meaning the land itself and not the pier
the island at the far reef
the island was the whole of the matter
the island had become a line in a map
The island of the whole thing
An island, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: chart the island 意为“测绘这座岛”，1966 年那位渡船人把海湾里没有一位水手肯记录的一座岛做了一遍。
island 意为“岛；岛屿”，指那座岛地本身而不是栈桥，它经过了三个月而在簿子上没有被记录。
island 意为“岛；岛屿”，指海湾里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一座短短的栈桥。
island 意为“岛；岛屿”，指最远那处礁石留给孩子们走到的一岸那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
island 意为“港湾、归宿”，指一件事里人人都登却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个港湾就是那件事的全部。
island 意为“归宿”，指人人都登却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座岛地，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
island 意为“岛；岛屿”，指海图里写到、被记下的的那一座，到 1971 年这一座成了海图里的一行。
island 意为“岛屿之事”，渡船人八月写道，整件事的岛之事是一处海湾和三个月的记录。
island 意为“岛；岛屿”，我记得的是海图里记录过的那一座，1973 年标注了，至今仍被说成海湾里最安静的一座。
island 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，岛是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的岛地。
